items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: We played with some of the best guys together. He got me on some of the best jobs that I could play on in New Orleans.

ctx.x: You let up my your friend, my man, that's the only man, and I was going to supper and drum about it one time. I don't know that one day. Tell them now.

And I don't want to get my own and there. You know the word Bo need a horse. That's what we called it. Always. Always. Huh? And we had some very good times together. We played with some of the best guys together. He got me on some of the best jobs that I could play on in New Orleans. And we had to do it. We played for the cream with the crocks on it. That's all I could say. We did.
Are you saying about the trombone and trumpet?
